anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format the dataset; it does not describe this spiral/color-word MEG dataset.

anchors.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
anchors.reason: iEEG-BIDS is a data-organization specification (BIDS extension); this dataset is MEG/EEG color-spiral data, so the paper is a standard, not its data paper.

metadata.methods_description: MEG data were recorded while participants viewed eight square wave spiral gratings subtending 10 degrees of visual angle and the color words "blue" and "green" in white on a gray background. Each stimulus was displayed for 116 ms, with event IDs 1-10 marking the stimulus identity (1-8 spiral gratings: light/dark pink, blue, green, orange; 9 "green"; 10 "blue").
